title: Relics of the Dead Gods
notes: The Reliquary (K, or the Relics button): six body slots, Eye, Throat, Heart, Hand, Spine and Wing / Tail, for the dead gods' own parts. Two are open at first; one more opens at Ascensions 20, 40, 60 and 80 (all six on New Game+). Right-click a part in your bag to set it in; click it in the Reliquary to take it out.

18 parts drop from Ascension 30 (bosses far more often): four each of Gylvor, Vyl and XyloFel, and six of Kryu. Kryu's parts are mismatched pieces of many creatures: they fit any slot, but each copies another god's part at 70%. Three of them together: We Are Many (full strength, and they count toward the god they copy).
Set bonuses for 2 and 4 parts of one god (Kryu: 2 and 3). See the new Game Guide page, The Reliquary.

Orbs of Concept now carry their god's on-hit effect, for any class: Erasure, Thornbloom, The Gavel Falls, Stormstrike, Grave Hand, Coin Toss, Pounce, Lullaby and Rift. 10% chance on every hit, +1% per rarity step (13% Legendary). A Herald's consumed Orbs keep it.

Every artifact of the gods has its own picture now (the Primer, the Morningstar, the Hourglass, the Glass Eye, the Tea Set...), and each Orb of Concept shows its idea inside the glass: a sprouting seed, tiny scales, a thundercloud, a spinning coin, paw prints.
